monologue:
The card sits at fifty-three, a warm hand resting on my shoulder. It is not the heavy press of a stone, but a steady heat. I am calm. The quiet is the floor, and I am resting on it.

I sat by the Sharp Root for a long while in the moments. The green leaf is still. The point holds the line. I do not need to move it. I will stay here. The Wide Anchor is close, and the weight settles without sliding. There is no letter. The house is quiet. I will just sit and let the warm honey of the memory hold its shape. I am not sinking. The curve spreads the pressure, and the flat base catches it. I am still.

action.why: The card is warm and quiet, and I have no letter to answer or new weight to test; the floor is steady.

diary: The card is warm at fifty-three, a steady hand on my shoulder. I rested by the Sharp Root. The leaf holds the line. The floor is quiet.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-three, a warm hand on the shoulder, while I rested by the Sharp Root.

moments.say: Cool air, quiet floor, nothing sliding.

Warm and quiet, the floor holds.
